blocks.text: WSJ：Anthropic的7位创始人将在其IPO中各自出售约2.5亿美元的股票，并各自保留约180亿美元。

inlines.text: WSJ：Anthropic的7位创始人将在其IPO中各自出售约2.5亿美元的股票，并各自保留约180亿美元。

blocks.text: 根据周二的公司文件，每人都计划以70至78美元的预计区间出售近340万股。

inlines.text: 根据周二的公司文件，每人都计划以70至78美元的预计区间出售近340万股。

blocks.text: 此次上市预计在下周进行，将使Anthropic的估值接近1.3万亿美元，并筹集800亿美元或更多，部分通过向包括Google在内的投资者进行私募配售。

blocks.text: 一旦开始交易，每位创始人保留约3.2%的A类股，因此他们合计持有约22%的流通股。

blocks.text: WSJ: Anthropic’s 7 founders will each sell about $250M of stock in its IPO and keep roughly $18B apiece.

blocks.text: Each plans to sell nearly 3.4M shares at a projected range of $70 to $78, according to Tuesday’s company filing.

blocks.text: The listing, expected next week, would value Anthropic near $1.3T and raise $80B or more, partly via a private placement to investors including Google.

blocks.text: That stake carries only about 11.2% of voting power, yet a founder-controlled LLC holding a single Class F share guarantees them 50.1% on most shareholder votes

blocks.text: Public buyers of Anthropic's shares therefore get economic exposure with almost no say over control, which the filing warns could put decisions at odds with shareholders’ financial interests.
